ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: skimmed from the take
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: Before the crew's take was ever counted, {PAWN_nameDef} skimmed a good share of it into {PAWN_possessive} own pocket. The rest of the crew have been short ever since without knowing why.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} counted something out for {B_nameDef} in a quiet corner, then counted it again. {B_nameDef} looked troubled afterwards.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said the crew should finally hear where their missing share went:

ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.label: in on the mutiny
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truth: {PAWN_nameDef} was in on the mutiny. When the crew turned, {PAWN_pronoun} sided with them, right up until it went wrong and {PAWN_pronoun} was thrown into the pods with the very people {PAWN_pronoun} had betrayed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.truthLowTech: {PAWN_nameDef} was in on the uprising that threw everyone out, and sided with the traitors right up until it went wrong and {PAWN_pronoun} was driven out with the very people {PAWN_pronoun} had betrayed.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.confide: {A_nameDef} and {B_nameDef} talked late about the crew they came down with, and which side people had been on.
ColonyCouncil.SecretDef.grave: {TELLER_nameDef} said {PAWN_nameDef} spent every day here making up for one bad choice, and told the others what it was:
